Message:
After Lady Elfriede was freed
from the demon’s control,
she declared an end to
the Church’s Witch Hunt.

However, the Inquisition is still
carrying out its own Witch Hunt
to this very day.

Whenever Lady Elfriede
hears such news,
I can see the pain written
all over her face...

At times like these,
I never know the right words
to offer Lady Elfriede...

“Oh? Are you also here to
have your fortune read?”

When I sought out Miss Loki,
she seemed to know that
I was coming.

“Elfriede was here
just a little while ago too.
She requested a reading to see
what fate had in store for her.
Yet, my tarot cards revealed...
nothing...”

“When I told her that,
she seemed almost...relieved.
I can’t help but feel
uneasy about that.”

“Elfriede always tries to bear
every burden on her own shoulders,

so I’ll try keeping an eye on her.
But, you should also
keep a close watch.

After all, the only one
who can truly do that is you—
her guardian knight.”

That’s right.
I’m the only knight she has left.
I must hold myself together...

Such is the duty of
a guardian knight...

Just as I felt my eyes
lowering to the floor,
Miss Loki held out
a tarot card to me.

“It appears you could use
some advice yourself.
Very well—I’ll give you
a special reading.”
